description: Validate a Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) profile document — the JSON a store publishes at /.well-known/ucp, or the profile an agent platform advertises — against the UCP specification: version format, required registries, service bindings and endpoints, capability entries and orphaned extensions, namespace authority binding of schema URLs, payment handlers, and signing keys (including leaked private key material). Pass the JSON text; this tool does not fetch URLs. Use it before publishing a profile or when a store or agent is rejected during UCP negotiation.

kind.description: Whose profile it is: a store ("business") or an agent platform ("platform"). Platform profiles must give spec and schema URLs.

profile.description: The profile document as JSON text.

name: ucp_profile_validate
title: Validate a UCP profile
